text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Brian. Is there anything you 
want?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Out of the blue, huh. If it's about my 
birthday, people already celebrated the 
moment the clock struck midnight. That's 
enough for me."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No can do. I've already prepared a cake, 
and Mom and Dad gave me presents to pass 
along to you too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I intended to prepare something 
myself, but I thought asking what you 
wanted for once wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's like this every year, but aren't 
you overdoing it a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a child anymore. There's no need 
to make a big deal out of—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? It's my little 
sister's birthday, isn't it? There's no 
such thing as going overboard. Just tell 
me what you want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...... Just running together with me is 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd grant something like that anytime. 
It's not a special wish you only make just 
because it's your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Once the gifts are set, the party begins. 
Invitations have already been sent to our 
friends, and the decorations are flawless. 
Theoretically, this should be a perfect 
start—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You're definitely getting too carried 
away, Sis.
